name: PerceptEye Agent Flywheel
description: Close the loop on your OpenClaw or DeepSeek Harness agent: record what your tools actually did — ok, failed or unknown — claim graded rollouts in training mode, and report them back. Never alters a tool result; set PERCEPTEYE_AGENT_MODE=production for an observe-only install.

apiKey.description: PerceptEye flywheel key (pefw_...). Without it the plugin records locally and contacts nothing.

agentId.description: The agent name this install reports as.

capture.description: Set false/0/off to disable local capture entirely.

unattended.description: In training mode, the plugin starts rollout turns itself rather than waiting for you to start one. Has NO effect in production mode. Set false/0/off to keep claiming rollouts but only deliver them into turns you start.

mode.description: training: this install claims rollouts and drives turns. production: observe-only -- the rollout hooks are never registered. Overrides PERCEPTEYE_AGENT_MODE.
